thesis: NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya announced a new $50 million autism data science initiative funded by 13 selected research teams to address rising autism prevalence. Additionally, the administration is reviewing the use of the old drug Luvorom for folate deficiency in autistic children and issuing caution regarding Tylenol use during pregnancy based on emerging evidence linking it to subsequent autism diagnoses.
